notes_for_editor: The history agrees across both lookout sites, and the site notes describe almost nothing left. Coordinates disagree by 762 m: FFLA 47.75567,-116.14272 vs Idaho 47.76131,-116.14851; the record uses the FFLA point. Neither source gives a staffing history or a fire. The existing photo in the record is from the Idaho site and needed no new find. Page reads: two lookout pages plus the FFLA list; one Shoshone County page added nothing.
